verdict.rationale: The product is itself a public API. It has a documented API reference (Responses create method), a quickstart with API-key setup, official SDKs plus a CLI and plain-HTTP option, and an official Python library that wraps the REST API. An llms.txt docs hub also returned HTTP 200, which makes the docs agent-discoverable. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed public paths (all returned 404).
